body:
CI-HEALTH BLOCKER — filed BUG-1176 (high). The CLI-manual drift-guard (verify-manual.py) flags-check hard-fails full-CI on 366 FALSE-POSITIVE citations: it reports --type/--title/--parent "cited under aida add" as unresolved, but aida add --help genuinely lists them. Reproduced locally, release binary, exit=1. The guard's flag-resolution is broken, not the docs.

It's full_ci-gated, so docs/code-only PRs skip it (main shows green), but EVERY full-CI PR (workflows/build) fails on it. First victim: PR-1746 (TASK-1205) — its fresh rebased CI is red solely on this step, nothing to do with its own CI-guard changes. So #1746 is BLOCKED by BUG-1176, not by any defect of its own; I'm NOT merging it. Joe's approval stands, but the merge waits on BUG-1176.

Prime suspect: TASK-1207 (#1749) hardened this guard + changed flag attribution to "exact command path"; #1749 was docs-only/path-filtered so its own CI skipped the guard and the broken hard-fail merged unseen (my proxy-merge of #1749 didn't catch it — the check never ran on that PR). My miss.

Recommendation: (b) demote the flags-check from hard_fail to ADVISORY now (one-line-ish change in verify-manual.py — keep completeness/spec-id/reflection as hard fails), which immediately unblocks all full-CI PRs incl #1746; (a) fix the flag-resolution false-positives as the real follow-up. This is a merge-guard change so I'm bringing it to you rather than unilaterally editing the guard — want me to take the (b) fix at the keyboard, or will you? Whoever does it, its own PR is docs-only so it'll path-filter past the very guard it fixes.
